title: Queen vs lone king
tip: Use the queen to shrink the king's box a knight's move away, then bring your own king up. Watch out for stalemate!

title: Two-rook ladder
tip: Rooks take turns: one cuts off a rank, the other checks. Walk the king to the edge like climbing a ladder.

title: Queen vs king (as Black)
goal: Checkmate with king and queen — this time with Black.
tip: Same technique from the other side: box the king in, then march your king closer.

title: Rook vs lone king
tip: The rook cuts the king off; your king must help. Use 'opposition' — kings facing each other — then check.

title: Promote the pawn
goal: Promote the pawn and then checkmate.
tip: Your king is already in front of the pawn on the 6th rank — that's a winning setup. Keep the opposition and escort the pawn home.

title: Up a rook
goal: Convert the extra rook into a win.
tip: Activate the rook (7th rank!), bring the king in, and create a passed pawn. Don't rush — just avoid blunders.

title: Up a queen, early game
goal: You're a queen up after the opening. Win the game.
tip: Develop your pieces, castle, and trade pieces when you can — every trade makes your extra queen stronger.

title: Queen vs a runaway pawn
tip: Check the king so it has to stand in front of its own pawn, then use that tempo to bring your king closer. Repeat.

title: Exploit the back rank
goal: Queen and rook against a lone rook — finish it.
tip: Black's king has no escape square. Look for checks on the back rank — and keep your own king safe.

title: Lucena position
goal: Promote the pawn and win the rook endgame.
tip: 'Build a bridge': bring the rook to the 4th rank, walk the king out, and block the checks with the rook.

title: Finish the attack
goal: Your pieces are aimed at the king. Break through.
tip: Look for checks and captures first. Pieces pointing at h7 are a clue.
